description: Google Cloud KMS config provider for Docker Swarm

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: project used for configs that carry no gcloud.project label

env.name: GCLOUD_LOCATION
env.description: key ring location used for configs that carry no gcloud.location label

env.name: GCLOUD_KEYRING
env.description: key ring used for configs that carry no gcloud.keyring label

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: path to a credentials file inside the plugin, e.g. /run/gcloud/key.json

env.name: GCLOUD_TIMEOUT
env.description: deadline for a single Cloud KMS call

env.name: GCLOUD_REQUIRE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
env.description: 1 refuses to start without a credentials file instead of falling back to ADC

mounts.name: gcloud
mounts.description: host directory holding credentials.json and any ciphertext files; set gcloud.source to your own
